Here’s a list of basic salad ingredients in checkbox format:

### **Base Greens**
- [ ] Lettuce (e.g., romaine, iceberg, butterhead)
- [ ] Spinach
- [ ] Arugula
- [ ] Mixed greens (spring mix, baby kale)

### **Vegetables**
- [ ] Cucumber (sliced or diced)
- [ ] Tomatoes (cherry, grape, or diced)
- [ ] Bell peppers (red, yellow, or green)
- [ ] Red onion (thinly sliced)
- [ ] Carrots (shredded or julienned)
- [ ] Radishes (sliced)
- [ ] Avocado (sliced or diced)

### **Protein (Optional)**
- [ ] Grilled chicken (sliced or shredded)
- [ ] Hard-boiled eggs
- [ ] Chickpeas or black beans
- [ ] Tofu (cubed or baked)
- [ ] Tuna or salmon (canned or fresh)
- [ ] Cheese (feta, goat cheese, cheddar, or parmesan)

### **Crunchy Add-Ins**
- [ ] Croutons
- [ ] Nuts (almonds, walnuts, pecans)
- [ ] Seeds (sunflower, pumpkin, sesame)
- [ ] Bacon bits

### **Dressing (Choose One)**
- [ ] Olive oil & balsamic vinegar
- [ ] Ranch
- [ ] Caesar
- [ ] Lemon-tahini
- [ ] Honey mustard
- [ ] Italian

### **Extras (Optional)**
- [ ] Dried fruit (cranberries, raisins)
- [ ] Fresh herbs (parsley, cilantro, basil)
- [ ] Olives (black or green)
- [ ] Pickles or pickled onions

Would you like a specific type of salad (e.g., Greek, Cobb, Caesar)? 😊
